launches.title: Every Benefits: Stop paying for health insurance your team doesn't use
launches.tagline: The smarter way to offer great benefits — without overpaying for coverage employees don't need
launches.body:
**TLDR**

Hey all, I run Every, the all-in-one HR and Finance platform. We are currently serving 2100 customers, including over 300+ YC startups.

Today we are launching Every Health Benefits. We combined our HR and Fintech stack to build a new way of funding health benefits that **saves the average startup $1,200 per employee per year** - while keeping the same carriers, networks, and employee experience.

Launch video: <https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=T59_0OouTEU&feature=youtu.be>

**Problem**

Healthcare is the second largest cost for many startups behind payroll, and every year costs are increasing while insurance coverage is staying the same or decreasing. Costs have climbed 24% over the last five years, according to[ KFF's Employer Health Benefits Survey.](https://www.kff.org/health-costs/2024-employer-health-benefits-survey/)

I have been the CEO at a startup for 10+ years now. The first few times I renewed benefits (at my previous startup) I thought my HR vendor was ripping me off. I don’t love being taken advantage of, so I got pretty upset and immediately started looking for a new vendor. When I did, I realized prices went up everywhere, and I was stuck paying thousands of dollars more for a product that wasn’t even improving.

The math is broken, and I was paying a lot of money is for benefits I knew my team was barely using.

Most startup teams skew young and healthy. The average startup employee never comes close to hitting their deductible, but given the war for talent, startups have to offer expensive Gold and Platinum level plans.

**Solution**

Every Benefits flips the model. Instead of paying higher premiums upfront to cover employee healthcare costs, employers choose a lower-premium plan and pair it with an employer-funded reimbursement arrangement. **Employees are reimbursed for eligible expenses as they're incurred**—so you are paying for benefits as costs are incurred, instead of before.

The result? Silver plan that feels like Gold. A Gold plan that feels like Platinum. Same carriers. Same networks. A $0 effective deductible experience for employees—at a meaningfully lower cost for employers.

**Savings**

For a 25-person company with average characteristics, this reduces annual benefits spend from approximately $261,000 to $230,000—about $31,000 in a typical year.

* **50 employees:** approximately $62,000 in typical-year savings
* **100 employees:** approximately $125,000 in typical-year savings
* **Average savings:** up to 12% on health benefits spend

_Savings figures are based on a 25-employee company on a small group, fully insured Platinum PPO. Actual savings depend on plan selection and utilization and may vary. Every Benefits is available in select states; see [every.io](http://every.io) for current availability._

**Ask**

If your company might be interested in this, I’d love to chat with you, please email me at [sales@every.io](mailto:sales@every.io).

launches.title: Every: Payroll that saves founders billions of dollars in fines
launches.tagline: Seamlessly hire in the US and 200+ countries around the world with compliance on autopilot
launches.body:
TLDR: We've built a [payroll platform](https://bit.ly/4jkjsUM) with built-in compliance\*\* that allows you to seamlessly hire in the US and 200+ countries around the world. Our platform frees founders from HR compliance headaches so they can focus on building their product.

[Payroll Sizzle Reel](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CS8htsL6t_k)

**The Problem**

**Founders aren't payroll experts, but the IRS doesn't care. Each year, businesses pay billions in payroll penalties.** US business owners face \~$6 billion in annual IRS penalties because most founders aren't payroll experts and struggle with compliance tasks.\
\
**The Every difference:** We perform manual compliance reviews before tax submission. After processing \~$60M in payroll, our customers have paid $0 in late/incorrect tax penalties.\
\
**New state, new employee, new headache.** Hiring in a new state means hours navigating unfamiliar government websites and processes—often including frustrating phone calls—to set up tax accounts and foreign qualifications before your new hire can get paid.

**The Every difference:** we set up your state tax accounts for you, and can also automate foreign qualifications, saving you many hours of painful busywork, ensuring not only that you are state tax accounts are registered properly, but proactively making sure your business is compliant, reducing unnecessary stress or possible fines

**Incumbent payroll systems are built for traditional SMBs, not tech startups.** Incumbent solutions were designed for traditional businesses with conventional workforces—not for tech startups with distributed teams, complex equity structures, and growth trajectories that can take you from three employees to thirty in a matter of months.

**The Every difference**: Built exclusively for tech startups, not restaurants or retailers. We've invested deeply in creating an intuitive experience that saves you time and provides clarity—something impossible for competitors trying to serve every industry at once.

**Our Solution**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=89698&key=user_uploads/886715/b2b84836-5cd9-440a-92f1-b86210b52c6d)

We provide a **comprehensive payroll solution** designed specifically for **tech startups**. We handle the complexity of payroll, compliance, and global hiring so you can put HR on autopilot.

* **We handle all the compliance stuff automatically** - As founders ourselves, we built the solution we wished we had: payroll taxes, offer letters with CIAAs, W-9 collection, and 1099 filing—all on autopilot. No more administrative headaches stealing your focus or surprise fines derailing your momentum.
* **We handle state tax account setup -** We handle state tax registrations and filings, saving our clients hours of work and helping them avoid penalties and paperwork.
* **We've made international hiring simple** - As founders, we needed a simpler way to hire internationally. Now you can bring on team members in 200+ countries through our EOR solution or work with international contractors using country-specific contracts—all managed in one place. No legal research, no compliance surprises, just building your best team regardless of borders.
* **We offer concierge support** - Every client gets their own Slack connect channel with our in-house specialists. These aren't outsourced support agents - they're actual payroll, benefits, and compliance experts who know your specific situation.
* **Compete for talent, protect your runway** - Our tech-specific health benefits packages are built for the modern startup. We've navigated these waters ourselves and created options that match what the giants offer without their massive budgets. A dedicated specialist will help you find the sweet spot between competitive benefits and financial sustainability.

**What YC Founders Say About Every:**

> We had some complicated situations (e.g. payroll for contractors), and Every handled them super well. We were literally set up within an hour for contractors and within a day for W2 payroll

> FYI we started with Rippling  but it was a nightmare to use. It's clearly not optimized for small teams with low overhead. We ended up switching to Every. Pricing is similar but you get a significantly simpler product and founder support, and you can email a human who responds promptly. Highly recommend!

> I initially tried to do Rippling and Gusto but got turned off by the friction with onboarding or with state filings. Every was 10 minutes (probably less)

> Haven't thought about payroll at all since onboarding onto Every. Rajeev and team are great!

**Ready for Payroll That Actually Works for Founders? Get Started Today!**

Visit [Every.io](https://bit.ly/4cGEESl) today to request a personalized tour. Getting started is remarkably fast—our dedicated experts will guide you through each step of setting up your tailored payroll system with built-in compliance, international capabilities, and ongoing support. From first click to fully operational in days, not weeks.

**Our Ask + $150 Referral Bonus**

Simply email [**sales@every.io**](mailto:sales@every.io) with your introduction. Help your founder friends save time while earning rewards!

Fixing these mistakes can cost thousands of dollars, lead to major delays when raising capital, and damage your reputation right when you need investor confidence the most.

### **Our Solution**

We have already incorporated 50+ Y-Combinator and Antler companies that successfully received investment with zero issues or need for legal re-work.
